parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (1.0072) as it performed worse than my best (0.9980). Increasing LR to 0.07 was not the right direction for this configuration. Reverting to DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=64, LR=0.06. I'll try a different approach: increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.10 to see if longer warmup helps stabilize the large capacity model.
